prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: high-quality original HAND-PAINTED fantasy-game BASIC ATTACK sprite source, FOUR full-body poses in an EXACT2×2 grid, transparentRGBA.
Input1 selected portrait: exact face, adult anatomy, costume and cool staff design. Input2 previous southeast casting sheet: match its painted2.5D volume and high camera, but FIX all crowding and overlap using a spacious2×2layout. Do not reproduce8figures.
CHARACTER: Lumi, clearly adult22 cute chestnut-curly-haired woman, naturally FULL BUST under fully covering high-neck blouse, defined NARROW WAIST, slender arms and legs, normal balanced adult proportions; not plus-size, not child/chibi. Same elegant dark-mage BLACK/MIDNIGHT PURPLE/SILVER arcane rune dress and huge crescent witch hat, black boots. Same full BLACK-SILVER star-ring staff, deep-purple crystal, tiny contained icy-blue crystal light. NO pink, no warm-gold costume. Exactly one Lumi per cell, no pet/companion on sheet.
CAMERA: all four poses face SOUTHEAST, front-right three-quarter facing lower-right on ground, fixed HIGH-ANGLE three-quarter OBLIQUE TOP-DOWN near-isometric. Entire head/body has real dimensional perspective; do not change direction or rotatebitmap.
STYLE: richly painted cartoon fantasy, SOLID2.5D hand-painted fabric, hair, skin and metal volume, warm upper-left sunlight and restrained spectral cyan highlights. Match reference detail, no flatvector, no stickfigures, no pixelart, no diagrams.
LAYOUT VERY IMPORTANT: native2048×2048square requested, exactly FOUR cells: upper-left, upper-right, lower-left, lower-right. Invisible equal2×2cells. Each character's HAT-TOP to SHOE-SOLE height approximately40%of WHOLEcanvas height (=80%ofcellheight). Preserve high detail at source scale. ENTIRE staff also fits INSIDE its cell. Every cell has at least8%ofcellwidth empty TRANSPARENT margin on all FOURsides. Absolutely no robe/staff/hat/finger crossing into a neighbor cell. No touching silhouettes. Keep characters isolated with a broad clean transparent cross-shaped gutter, transparent outside borders.
All poses same overall scale, centered within cell, same foot-ground center relative to cell. Clothes may react to body movement but don't extend outside safety margin. Keep staff close to body and mostly upright as a focus; do not throw it horizontally acrosscell. Full hat, full hand, full staffhead and stafftail, both legs/boots UNCROPPED.
This is BASIC ATTACK: Lumi directs her separately-rendered star companion with a brisk pointing gesture. She does NOT fire a big staff beam. NO pet, NO magical projectile, NO trails, NO particles/bloom/aura, NO floating attackeffects around body. Crystal may have small cyan internal light only. True bodily movement in shoulders/elbows/wrists/torso, small weightshift and coherent cloth lag.
BACKGROUND: every pixel outside the four persons and their staffs must be TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha0, no gradients, no floor, no shadows, no opaque cellbackgrounds, no gridlines, no text, no numbers, no labels, no watermark. Only four complete independent mages. Requested native2K; don't upscale a smaller raster.
THIS IMAGE IS SEQUENCE A: frames0–3, ordered row-major:
UPPER-LEFT frame0 PREPARATION1 / neutral light-command stance: feet planted balanced, staff held upright beside body by right hand, left directing hand relaxed near waist, eyes looking down-right.
UPPER-RIGHT frame1 PREPARATION2: small knees/hip weightshift, left elbow lifts directing hand to chestheight, wrist begins turning, staff hand flexes slightly, curl/cape respond.
LOWER-LEFT frame2 PREPARATION3: left forearm raises and prepares to point forward-down-right, fingers neatly open with index ready, torso slight windback, staff remains close.
LOWER-RIGHT frame3 FIRST RELEASE: short decisive pointing command down-right with LEFT indexhand, shoulder/torso lean a little into command; staff stays within cell upright/slightly angled, cloth follows. NO beam or visible projectile.
The four poses are consecutive animationframes with same face/clothes/scale. Count exactly4.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: safely spaced four-frame2×2sprite SOURCE.
Keep all FOUR adult mage poses, same face, detailed painting, black/purple/silver costume, slim full-bust narrow-waist body, southeast camera direction and complete star-ring staff. Keep the exact existing action sequence. NO pet, no particle effects, no aura or projectile.
ONLY fix composition and spacing: redraw each full person plus staff about85% of its CURRENT SIZE and center it independently in its assigned quarter. This is layout correction generated by you, not a software upscale. All four objects must have same consistent scale.
The whole image remains SQUARE, requested native2048x2048 if supported. Exactly2columns×2rows. For a1254square output, invisible cell boundaries are x0/627/1254 and y0/627/1254. ENTIRE person INCLUDING STAFF must fit inside these safe rectangles:
upper-left x50–577,y50–577;
upper-right x677–1204,y50–577;
lower-left x50–577,y677–1204;
lower-right x677–1204,y677–1204.
Do not draw those rectangles or numbers. Those are placement constraints ONLY.
Character HAT-TOP to SHOE-SOLE height about500px at1254output, total person+staffheight NO MORE THAN527px. Center body at x313(top-left/bottom-left) orx940(right cells). Foot sole bottom at y565(top row) or1192(bottom row). Staffhead must be below safe topedge, stafftail above safe bottomedge. Full boots and staff uncropped.
At least50pixels TRUE TRANSPARENT EMPTY MARGIN inside EVERYquarter on EVERYside at1254output (proportionally82px at2048). Broad empty transparent vertical and horizontal gutter. ABSOLUTELY NOTHING may cross the center line, including hair, robe, fingertips, staff crystal, dangling ornament or magical glow. NO tiny stray decorative particles near edge.
Preserve rich original hand-painted2.5D cloth/hair/face/metal detail, warm sunlight. Do not turn into crude outline or chibi. Preserve true changing anatomy/gestures of the supplied poses, not identical cloned person.
True RGBA transparent background, no painted background, no floor/shadow, no grid, no text, no borders. Four separate independent full mages only.

notes: Four complete clearly separated source figures. All center-line pixels havealpha0. No software image editing, masking, repainting or scaling. landmark_annotation.coordinate_space: original1254x1254PNG; origin top-left; xright,y down; no cropping or scaling
landmark_annotation.method: Manual visual annotation. Visible hair top was corroborated within hand-selected head ROIs by warm chestnut pixels (alpha>=128); hats/staff/FX excluded. Boot contact centers were hand judged. Occluded rear boots explicitly estimated.
landmark_annotation.foot_anchor_definition: arithmetic mean of the two sole-contact center xy points; not the lowest boot-bottom pixel
landmark_annotation.position_accuracy_unit: pixels; conservative manual error bound, not calibrated certainty

frames.notes: Both sole contact centers visibly identifiable; near toe and far heel contact are judged across the sole, not the lowest single pixel.
Both boot soles visible; raised/angled far boot contact center remains a hand estimate.
Near boot visible. Far boot is concealed by the right skirt panels; far contact is estimated from leg direction and adjacent standing preparation pose.
Near boot visible. Only part of the far boot/sole appears under the skirt; its center is estimated, not measured as a full visible sole.
